summary: Comprehensive independent blind review of the final expanded Cats 32-requirement, 44-task plan. All 8 concrete architectural, concurrency, permission, and mathematical defects identified in Round 1 (DEF-01 through DEF-08) have been rigorously and completely repaired. The two latest founder additions—Requirement R31 / Task 43 (Durable Multi-Generation Lineage & Hybrid Breed Naming) and Requirement R32 / Task 44 (Expanded Functional Customization & 64+ Furnishings)—have been integrated as full vertical slices across requirements, issue mirrors, contracts, architecture, and additive gauntlet gates without weakening historical criteria. All original Task 01–32 criteria and the base .gauntlet/bar/BAR.md remain 100% byte-for-byte identical to baseline. Planning validation passes all 6 test suites with 0 errors. There are zero material unresolved defects.

DEF-01.title: In-memory broadcast in serverless environment
DEF-01.resolution: SSE route handler queries PostgreSQL coop_commands via asynchronous generator polling loop (250-500ms) with connection pool bounds and req.signal.onabort cancellation.

DEF-02.title: Ambiguous server-side reduction of coop_commands
DEF-02.resolution: POST /coop/command runs canonical dispatch() server-side within a PostgreSQL transaction holding row locks (SELECT ... FOR UPDATE); state, revision, event, and receipt commit atomically before SSE visibility.

DEF-03.title: Missing consolidated Actor Permission Matrix
DEF-03.resolution: Codified comprehensive 21-route permission matrix across Anonymous, Non-Member, Family Member, Owner, Host Leader, and dev test hooks into docs/contracts.md and coop-plan/CONTRACTS.md.

DEF-04.title: Undefined cat custody upon member revocation
DEF-04.resolution: Established Profile Alpha (Owner, max 4) and Profile Beta (Invitee, max 4). Member revocation terminates session but never deletes cats; cats remain in Beta under Owner SharedCare; explicit REASSIGN_CAT_CUSTODY route handles capacity and moves gestating litters atomically.

DEF-05.title: Unbounded table growth and missing cursor compaction
DEF-05.resolution: Separated ephemeral 15-minute event log (coop_commands) from durable command receipts (command_receipts); actorSeq <= min_retained_seq rejects stale commands with 409 Conflict; compacted Last-Event-ID triggers snapshot_reload.

DEF-06.title: Division by zero in Trait 2 weight redistribution
DEF-06.resolution: Added pre-conception validation (|PA ∪ PB| >= 2) rejecting invalid legacy parents before pregnancy under Policy Beta; under Policy Alpha, exhausted pools draw 100% from novel catalog fallback with recorded provenance; zero division by zero possible.

DEF-07.title: Missing rarity weights and encounter schedule persistence
DEF-07.resolution: Codified exact category weights (70/24/5/0.75/0.25) and active simulation time pacing (1 real sec = 1 sim min; 60 sim min window; 0 delta when paused/offline); encounters persist in world.neighborhood.activeEncounters.

DEF-08.title: Trait count constraint not explicit in Cat Creator spec
DEF-08.resolution: Canonical 2-trait invariant codified across architecture, contracts, and Task 39 while leaving historical Task 04 acceptance criteria 100% byte-for-byte identical to baseline HEAD.
